headline: The U.S. military withdraws from Iraq over 2 decades after its invasion
context: 23 years after the United States military invaded Iraq, sparking an insurgency and a civil war, the U.S. has withdrawn its forces, as the country still tries to combat Iranian influence.

sources.name: NPR
